items.summary: Meridian Funds, managed by ArrowMark Partners, released its third-quarter 2026 investor letter for “Meridian Hedged Equity Fund”. The letter can be downloaded here. In the quarter, a modest gain in U.S. equities masked a significant sector rotation and sharply narrowing leadership. The S&P 500 rose 2.30% in the quarter, bringing the year-to-date gain to 12.75%.
